title: Chapter 250
text:

Geniuses will remember 'Love Go Go Small' in one second. Talk → Net, providing you with interesting novels to read.

Han Xiao's true identity attracted the attention of all the major organizations. Zero could be said to be the initiator of the war, and Black Phantom was a powerful mechanic and assassin who stood at the peak of the world. Combining the two resumes together, the major organizations seemed to see the rise of another legendary star.

It had been many years since such a legendary figure appeared.

Now that he had the key information that affected the war, he had become the center of the storm. Naturally, he was the center of attention.

Four days after the news was released, almost all the major organizations in the world knew about Han Xiao's identity. Two organizations received the most attention.

One was the Overmera family, which was the birthplace of Han Xiao's original body. Many small organizations in the Northern Continent visited, and under Han Xiao's influence, the Overmera gained many new allies. At the same time, the news that Han Xiao had become the elder of the Xiao Faction spread like wildfire.

This ridiculous story became a stain on the Xiao Faction that could not be washed away. Looking at everyone who was trying to hold back their laughter, Xiao Hai felt terrible and wanted to commit suicide.

The other was the Dark Net. Han Xiao was now a high-ranking member of the Dark Net. However, the major organizations found out that the Dark Net had not done anything, and no one knew what their attitude was.

In the blink of an eye, four days had passed.

…

Looking down from the sky, the sandy yellow wilderness was filled with smoke. A ferocious-looking off-road vehicle was traversing the wilderness, dragging a cloud of dust behind it. A kilometer or two behind the vehicle, a Germinal Organization's search team was chasing after it.

"Four days, this is the thirteenth team."

In the passenger seat, Han Xiao was controlling the camera installed at the back of the car to observe the situation of the search team. He shook his head and said, "So few people, here to deliver parts again."

"…" Hella, who was driving, glanced at him. She was so tired that she didn't want to say anything.

The two of them looked like polar opposites right now. They had been on the run for four days, and enemies were everywhere. There were high-intensity battles every day, and Hila was not the Great Mechanic Han who used machines to fight. Her strength came from her own Esper Ability, and her Esper Ability consumed energy and stamina. Every battle was a tough battle for her, and she was completely exhausted. Her face was covered in dust, and there were dark circles under her eyes.

However, Han Xiao was completely different. Using the modified Viper mech in battle, he was calm and relaxed. Moreover, most of the enemies chasing after him were crushed by him. In contrast, Hella could not deal with the enemies as easily as he could.

As Hella drove, she felt like she was going to fall asleep at any moment. Even if she was tired, she didn't want to give the steering wheel to Han Xiao — one side was a cliff, and the other was an abyss. At least there was a bottom to the cliff …

"Sis, do you want some juice?" Aurora, who was sitting in the back, looked out and passed a silver bag of liquid.

"This is not called juice. It's a synthetic refreshment drink used to relieve fatigue and raise the spirit. You can't …" Han Xiao looked back and saw the empty bags in the back seat. His mouth twitched, and he said, "… drink more."

"But it's delicious."

Aurora shrunk her head.

When she was imprisoned, her daily food was the same nutrition paste. This refreshment drink was a new delicacy to her, and now, she was especially energetic.

At the beginning of the escape, there was only one Han Technician, and they had to rely on snatching resources. This kind of long-distance chase was the stage for Mechanics to show their advantage. They could eliminate the pursuers, dismantle their equipment, and turn them into parts. Then, they could create their own weapons.

In the Pro League, Mechanics were highly sought after in survival matches where there were external factors.

Other than military canned food and some energy drinks, there were also a lot of parts. Han Xiao modified their off-road vehicle. The internal engine, cylinder, and so on were all optimized, and it ran like a wild bull. There were traces of modification everywhere on the exterior, and it was very wild.

The Germinal Organization's troops were restrained by the Six Nations, which reduced their pressure by more than half. The Six Nations also took care of the missile interception problem, so he did not have to worry about a missile being thrown at him if he fought in one place for too long.

Han Xiao looked at the rearview mirror and said, "Turn around and deal with them. Little brat, lie under the seat and don't show your head."

Aurora obediently did as she was told.

Hella was expressionless. She took the drink, squeezed it hard, and drank it in one gulp. Then, she turned the steering wheel, and the off-road vehicle made a fierce tail-sweep, stirring up waves of dust, and charged at the pursuers like a bull.

Han Xiao quickly finished changing his equipment, and his appearance changed drastically. In order to adapt to the chase battle, he modified Viper and added a lot of long-range weapons, such as triple cannon on both arms, grenade launchers on both shoulders, extra magazines on both legs and back, and yellow bullet belts that wrapped around his body like ribbons. These were all taken from the enemy.
